source_relation: Historical Bishal Paija subcontract clauses are conceptual precedents only. Do not copy confidential parties, prices, brand specs, penalties, subcontract restrictions or old time periods.

clause_families.rule: Written included works and exclusions control commercial obligations. Distinguish general structural/services works from specific finishing/compound works.
Signed Appendix A drawing register governs technical details only. Require number, revision, date, attachments and signature before treating drawings as contract documents.
Changes in scope, materials, drawings, price or programme require both parties' prior written approval. Structural deviations may require qualified engineer review.
Workmanship and materials require specifications and approved substitutions; differentiate owner-supplied materials and contractor-supplied materials.
Financial schedule must reconcile against contract value. Written event certification required for commencement and completion milestones; due days are a project-specific approved term.
Specify final withheld instalment versus proportionate deductions, start event, calendar duration and release prerequisites. No invented deductions.
DLP appears separately from last payment trigger; DLP duration does not itself delay the retained final instalment unless expressly agreed.
Demolition and material title transfer must be clearly stated; confirm lawful authority, third-party rights, permitted recovery, safety and waste disposal.
Provide written notice, fair cure opportunity, negotiation and legally reviewed dispute routes; never copy historical penalties or interest rates by default.
Do not issue an agreement before party authority, taxes, dates, signed appendices, payment terms and legal review are resolved.

public_private.public: template control and safe formatting only
public_private.private: parties, project clause choices, approved rates, drawings, signatures
